data.title: Nvidia building 1-trillion-parameter Nemotron 4 to rival open AI models, The Information reports
data.description: Nvidia is developing a new AI model family, Nemotron 4, with the goal of challenging top open-source models globally, The Information ‌reported on Tuesday, citing people who work on the project.  The chip giant ‌is among the few major U.S. firms to release open-source models, which have drawn more attention this ​year as AI bills balloon and cheap Chinese models near the capabilities of top systems from leading American labs Anthropic and OpenAI.  A spate of recently disclosed hacks involving autonomous AI agents has added to the attention, especially because open models do not have ‌curbs on cybersecurity use.
data.keywords: Nvidia, open models, The Information, model family
